title: Perturbative Approach to Nonlinear Capacitance Matrix Formulations
summary: We study a nonlinear Helmholtz system with cubic nonlinearity on high-contrast inclusions in three dimensions, and the solitons that emerge as the contrast $δ$ tends to zero. Using the Dirichlet-to-Neumann operator and a capacitance formalism, we develop a perturbative cascade that expands the resonant frequency and field in powers of $\sqrtδ$.
